title: JenaAtomicCalculator (JAC): a Julia package for atomic structures, processes and cascades
description:
JAC, the Jena Atomic Calculator, is an open-source Julia package for relativistic atomic structure and collision computations. It provides interaction amplitudes, atomic properties, a wide range of excitation and decay processes, cascade simulations and the symbolic evaluation of expressions from Racah's algebra, for open-shell atoms and ions across the periodic table.

This record archives one released version of the source code. For the method, please cite Fritzsche, Comput. Phys. Commun. 240, 1-14 (2019); for the specific version you ran, cite this record.
